The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 641d4aa3892adbca), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The manuscript presents this as a result of other work, which it uses; the attribution names that work in the manuscript's own words. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (Y, h) be a complete connected one-ended three-dimensional AF manifold with smooth compact outer-minimizing minimal boundary. Assume Rh ≥ 0, h − δ = O2(|y|−β) for some β > 1/2, and Rh = O(|y|−q) for some q > 3. If the total boundary area is A, then mAF(h) ≥ √︂ A/(16π). (2.2) Disconnected boundary is allowed.
